title: Butterfly Clipart, 12 Butterflies and Dragonflies PNG and SVG, Monarch, Blue Morpho, Swallowtail, Damselfly, Garden Sublimation Designs
description:
Twelve butterfly and dragonfly clipart designs: a monarch, a blue morpho, a tiger swallowtail, a red admiral, a little blue butterfly, a monarch caterpillar on a milkweed leaf, a monarch on a purple coneflower, a blue dragonfly, a red dragonfly, a green darner, a blue damselfly on a reed and a teal dragonfly on a pink water lily. Each one comes as a full-color PNG with a transparent background at 300 dpi, plus a one-color SVG line-art version of the same design.

Use them for tees and sweatshirts, sublimation mugs and tumblers, tote bags, cards, invitations, stickers, scrapbooks, classroom and garden crafts, all year round. The designs are drawn in a cheerful flat style with clean dark outlines, so they stay crisp on light and dark backgrounds, and the butterflies and dragonflies keep colors close to the real species.

THE 12 DESIGNS
1 Monarch butterfly · 2 Blue morpho butterfly · 3 Tiger swallowtail · 4 Red admiral butterfly · 5 Monarch caterpillar · 6 Little blue butterfly · 7 Monarch on a coneflower · 8 Blue dragonfly · 9 Red dragonfly · 10 Green darner dragonfly · 11 Damselfly on a reed · 12 Dragonfly on a water lily

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 12 PNG files, transparent background, 300 dpi, 3600 px on the longest side (12 in), ready for sublimation, print and print-then-cut
• 12 SVG files: the same designs as single-layer, one-color line art that scales to any size
• One ZIP download with a README and the license

GOOD TO KNOW
• The SVGs are line-art versions for one-color printing, recoloring and crafts, not vinyl cut files: some lines are fine
• There is no text on the designs
• All designs are original clipart, simplified for printing rather than drawn as field-guide illustrations
• The tee, card and tote in the photos show the designs in use; you receive the digital files only
• Colors vary a little between screens, printers and blanks

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on physical items you make and sell (tees, mugs, tumblers, totes, cards, stickers), up to 500 items per design. Please don't resell, share or upload the digital files, use them on print-on-demand marketplaces, or include them in other digital products.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
